visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Indoor kitchen setting. A man with glasses wears a white shower cap, tan t-shirt, and a black apron. He wears long pink rubber gloves and holds a purple detergent bottle near a stainless steel sink filled with dishes. Yellow text appears at the top frame. (2) A rapid transition occurs with heavy vertical motion blur and light streaks. (3) Outdoor night setting. The same man is transformed into a youthful student wearing a white collared shirt, black knit vest, and tie. He carries a green shoulder bag. The background is a dark garden area with low lighting. (4) The student persona poses on a rooftop overlooking a city at night. The background features colorful bokeh lights from buildings. He interacts with a white smartphone, looking directly into the lens. (5) A blonde woman is shown from behind, holding a phone to record the man as he poses on a stone bench in a modern outdoor plaza. The camera shows the smartphone's interface during recording. (6) Close-up shots of a white smartphone are featured, highlighting its dual camera lenses and a bright LED flash that illuminates the frame. (7) High-quality portrait photographs are displayed full-screen with technical data watermarks at the bottom. (8) Return to the kitchen. The man is kneeling on a black computer keyboard on a white tiled floor, pointing a finger towards the camera with a guilty expression while wearing the apron and pink gloves.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic pop music begins immediately with a driving 4/4 kick drum and bright synthesizer pads. (2) A sharp, synthetic 'whoosh' sound effect marks a transition. (3) A male voice begins speaking in Traditional Chinese with a friendly and highly animated tone, maintaining clear enunciation. (4) Rhythmic camera shutter clicking sounds are layered onto the music, synchronized with rapid visual changes. (5) The background music maintains a consistent, upbeat energy throughout the feature demonstration. (6) A final digital 'ding' effect signals a narrative shift. (7) A second male voice shouting a rhetorical question enters at a high volume, while the background music abruptly stops, ending in near studio silence.
